description: Every morning: new mentions of your name or product on the web, forums and news, with the ones worth answering first.
instructions_md: Search for new mentions of {{names}} from the last 24 hours: news, blogs, forums such as Reddit and Hacker News, and review sites you can read without signing in. For each: where, who, the date, one line on what they said, whether it's positive, negative or a question, and a link. Put questions and complaints first, and suggest a short reply for each, as a draft. Leave out my own posts and pages, and mentions you've shown me before (keep a list in memory). Don't post or reply anywhere. If there's nothing new, say so in one line.
